== Biography ==
Nancy was born about 1836. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-1701|James Glasgow]].  
<ref>Inferred from the funeral mourners list.</ref>

She passed away at Killycurragh unmarried on 26 Aug 1896, age 60.
<ref>[https://www.britishnewspaperarchive.co.uk/viewer/bl/0002006/18960905/067/0005 "Miss Nancy Glasgow"], ''Mid-Ulster Mail'' - Saturday 05 September 1896, Page 5</ref>
The chief mourners were:
* [[Glasgow-1700|Thomas J Glasgow]], [[Glasgow-1703|Allen Glasgow]], John Glasgow, [[Glasgow-1722|Samuel J Glasgow]] (brothers)
* [[Henry-6237|Silas W Henry]] (brother-in-law)
* William J, Silas, [[Glasgow-2008|Thos H]], James, John, [[Glasgow-1723|Fred C]], Thomas John, and Johnston Glasgow; [[Henry-8397|Bismark Henry]], Thomas J Glasgow (nephews)

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1701]] is assessed at 97% (proved). Nancy's 1896 funeral names Thomas J, Allen, John and Samuel J as brothers, linking her to sons whose marriages name James. The same James junior family monument supplies an additional direct household anchor.

Selected Glasgow-1701 fatherhood of Glasgow-1707; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.

No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


The nephew "Johnston Glasgow" might be her nephew [[Glasgow-1705|Silas Johnston Glasgow (1864-)]] , with the other nephew Silas Glasgow being [[Glasgow-1696|Silas Ebenezer Glasgow (1867-1928)]] -- although I currently don't have relationships in place that would make him her nephew. (So maybe not...)  "Thos H" is the brother of Silas Johnston though.

The death of Nancy Glasgow was registered on 26 August 1896 in Cookstown, aged 53.<ref>[https://geni.nidirect.gov.uk/search/death GRONI civil death index], Nancy Glasgow, 26 August 1896, aged 53, Cookstown registration district, D/1896/99/1009/15/454.</ref>
